title: Shinonome Ena — Outstretched Hand〔Part1〕Side Story (Part 1)

meta.Event: What's on your mind? Exciting Picnic!

rows.Line: Diner

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Here's to another new song successfully uploaded... Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Kanade & Mafuyu
rows.Line: Cheers.

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Cheers!

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
Alright, let's dig in♪
I'm starving...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hehe. Before we do that...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Oh, right. Your obligatory social media pic...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Duh... Why do you think I got this?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Haha. Yeah, it is pretty colorful, and it looks delicious too...!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But you're not getting any, got it?

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: Aww, come on! Not even one little bite?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: Would you like some of my tart, Mizuki? I'm not sure how it tastes anyway so...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: You sure? Sweet♪

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mizuki's seemingly in a good mood...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Mizuki's usually the one that wants to celebrate like this, but I was the one that had to push for it this time...)

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: (Getting Mizuki to go out shopping hasn't been easy lately either. Plus, I haven't been getting as many jabs about posting photos online as I usually do...)

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line: *Blow*... *Blow*...

rows.Speaker: Kanade
rows.Line: Oh, is it still too hot for you?

rows.Speaker: Mafuyu
rows.Line: You should've gotten something other than the skillet steak...

rows.Speaker: Mizuki
rows.Line:
But I really wanted to try it♪
*Blow*... *Blow*...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
(We're all having fun but...
Something still doesn't feel right...)
Shinonome Household - Living Room

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I'm back.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Finally, you're home.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: There's something I want to ask you. Has Mizuki been going to school lately?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Akiyama? Nah, not for a while...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh, okay...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You went out with your group today, right? Did you see Akiyama there?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Yeah, but I was wondering how things were going at school...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Why are you asking me? Can't you just ask Akiyama?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm asking because it's hard to get anything out of Mizuki...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Okay...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: If that's the case, I have a teammate who's pretty close with Akiyama too. Want me to see if she can ask for you instead?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Oh... No, I don't want to do that to you. It's not that serious or urgent so...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I'm heading up to my room...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Uh, alright...
A few days later

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Thanks for the food.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, before I forget...
Akito, you'll need to wake me up tomorrow morning.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: What? Why?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Please, just do it. There's this thing I absolutely have to do tomorrow.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: That just means you're going shopping or something, right?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: No, I'm meeting up with Airi!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: And she's introducing me to one of her friends! You know, Shizuku Hinomori, the former lead for Cheerful Days? I'm not missing this chance!

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: *Sigh*... You really can't just wake up on your own?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: I will. I just want some insurance just in case too...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line:
Fine, whatever...
Just don't cause trouble for anyone else, okay...?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Good boy! Thanks, Akito!
Scramble Crossing

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: There! We even got here before Airi!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Hey, what if I got you Hinomori's autograph as a reward for waking me up?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: You're just saying that because you want one too...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Momoi's not introducing you to her for that sort of purpose either, right? Like I said, try not to cause anyone else trouble...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Of course I wouldn't do that. Airi is a dear friend of mine.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Anyways, I'm going...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Okay, bye.
You're meeting up with your team, right?

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Yeah.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: But if I knew that I'd have this much time I would've tagged along with you before coming here.

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Huh? Why?

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Because you said two of your teammates are girls. I've been wondering what they're like...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: Well, too bad...

rows.Speaker: Akito
rows.Line: I only came here because I have work later. Plus, we usually meet somewhere else, so your chances of meeting them are pretty low.

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: What? Are you deliberately trying to keep me from...?

rows.Speaker: Airi's Voice
rows.Line: There she is! Ena, over here!

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Oh, Airi's here!
Akito, you should at least say hi...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line:
Huh? Where'd he go?
Whatever, his loss...

rows.Speaker: Ena
rows.Line: Be right there, Airi!
